actualEntryInspections.limits: Neither definition guarantees a correct answer or an exclusive written-versus-spoken distribution. Related-word lists do not prove unrestricted substitutability.

Outside/exterior is an explicit ordinary sense at おもて, not the separate ひょう chart reading.
The English opening label also names an aperture or beginning. This is English polysemy, not Japanese synonymy.

recognitionContrast.reason: A separate 帰す at きす means end in or attribute to. The send-home identity remains 1221240 at かえす; no frequency, easier-level or independent N2 assignment is inferred.
